paragraphs.text: Goldmeadow is the name of a kithkin clachan in Lorwyn and the pastures around it. It is known for its stock of Goats . Its Shadowmoor counterpart is Mistmeadow .

Goldmeadow is one of the smaller clachans. Built within a vast meadow filled with standing stones and wildflowers, the settlement is ringed with farms. A high wall surrounds a large and somewhat irregular assortment of buildings, with a tall central watchtower nestled in the middle. Its small but hardy town watch keeps the clachan safe. For every farmer and springjack shepherd tending the fields, there's a soldier in training for the peasant militia. Sometimes they're even one and the same. The wind that ambles through Goldmeadow mixes the smells of spring wheat and oiled battle-leather.
Goldmeadow is due west of the Wanderwine River and the Gilt-Leaf Wood .
